output_list.criticism: The approveAndCall function can be called by a malicious contract. If it sends _value tokens to _spender and it fails, the tokens are still sent to _spender and will be lost. If it sends _value tokens to _spender and it succeeds, the contract has spent _value tokens, and the contract will never receive any tokens. A malicious contract has the ability to use this vulnerability to take control of the contract. This is the highest severity of any vulnerability found.

The transferFrom function can be called by a malicious contract. If it sends _value tokens to _to and it fails, the tokens are still sent to _to and will be lost. If it sends _value tokens to _to and it succeeds, the contract has spent _value tokens, and the contract will never receive any tokens. A malicious contract has the ability to use this vulnerability to take control of the contract. This is the highest severity of any vulnerability found.
